Archival Dispatch: 23 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Roy Acuff, Aladdin's Lamp, Benny Goodman, and Let's Pretend

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Roy Acuff, Grand Ole Opry, Smoky Mountain Boys, Aladdins Lamp, Smilin Ed McConnell, Benny Goodman, Martha Tilton, Peggy Lee, Lets Pretend, Nila Mack, Cream of Wheat, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 68 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 68 recovers and dates 23 classic radio broadcasts spanning Grand Ole Opry royalty, 1930s singing philosophies, swing era ballroom remotes, and Peabody-winning CBS children's audio dramatizations: 6 high-energy country and western performances from the King of Country Music on The Roy Acuff Show (1954, sponsored by Royal Crown Cola with the Smoky Mountain Boys), 6 heartwarming acoustic song and story sessions from Aladdin's Lamp with Smilin' Ed McConnell (1937), 5 classic big band swing recordings from Benny Goodman and His Orchestra (1937–1941, featuring vocalists Martha Tilton, Helen Forrest, and Peggy Lee), and 6 beloved fairy tale adaptations from Nila Mack's Let's Pretend (1944–1947, broadcast on CBS for Cream of Wheat).
